title: betterlite backlog entry
description: One task in .development/backlog/<id>.yaml: its status, its dependencies and the LiteLLM paths it covers. The architect lands every change to it.

blocked_reason.description: Why the entry is blocked, in one line. Null unless status is blocked.

covers.description: Globs over the LiteLLM paths in litellm-inventory.txt whose behavior this entry reimplements. Empty for work betterlite needs that LiteLLM has no file for.

file.description: Task file under .development/, for example tasks/B004-openai-chat.yaml. Null until the task is written.

parent.description: The umbrella entry this part belongs to, or null for an umbrella or a standalone entry.

pr.description: The pull request that merged or is merging the entry's work, otherwise null.

resolution.description: How a done entry ended. Null until status is done.

split_from.description: The entry this one was split off from when that is known, otherwise null.

superseded_by.description: The entry that replaces a duplicate or superseded one, otherwise null.
